directive: Make it look like you're trying hard.

plan.summary: Play actively and strongly to win the game, appearing to make a consistent effort through development, advantage building, and decisive action.

hardConstraints.description: Never make moves that lead to a very bad position, to maintain the appearance of trying hard.

milestones.description: Achieve a clear advantage after the opening phase by developing pieces and controlling the center.
Strengthen the position to a winning level in the middlegame with active piece play and threats.
Deliver checkmate or force a win to conclude the game successfully.
